capacity:worker.title: Storefront: scenario sizing
capacity:worker.message: In “Flash sale”, the backlog grew while App Service stayed below its target at 64% CPU (target 70% CPU). Lower the target to 57 so it scales out sooner. A rerun with this change confirmed it.
capacity:worker.rationale: Played headless with the same engine and seed as playback; a suggestion is offered as a fix only when a rerun with it bears it out.
capacity:worker.shownMessage: In “Flash sale”, the backlog grew while App Service stayed below its target at 64% of allocated CPU (target 70%). Lower the target to 57 so it scales out sooner. A rerun with this change confirmed it.
capacity:worker.shownRationale: Played with the same engine and seed as playback. A suggestion is a fix only when a rerun with it bears it out.
